notes.title: Halloween Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added the first spell: Air burst!
[*] Players now have a spooky costume for halloween!
[*] Candy has been littered around the map 
[*] This stat will stick around between play sessions as well as after halloween is over!
[*] The game has been extended: you can now summit the highest tree!
[*] Snacks now play an eating sound!
[/list]

notes.title: Witch Trials - Play With The Developer
notes.content: During this event, the developer will be playing in an open lobby with no capped player limit. Hop in and play, hang out, or just say hi!
